title: City Reminds Residents to Renew Senior Property Tax Exemption Status
summary: The City of Syracuse Department of Assessment is reminding eligible seniors to renew their property tax exemption status by January 1, 2027. Renewal forms will be mailed in August to registered residents; newly eligible applicants can apply online or in-person. The exemption requires applicants to be 64+, own their primary residence for at least one year, and have combined household income below $58,400.
